title: Welcome to Tensor Street
dek: A free daily briefing on the AI economy: what launched, what moved, what it means for your business.
body:
AI is no longer one story. It's a hundred stories a day, spread across lab blogs, earnings calls, court rooms, startup pitch decks and the small business down the street that quietly automated its scheduling.

Tensor Street pulls those threads into one place, keeps it updated from morning to night, and tells you what matters.

## What you'll find here

- **The Brief.** The handful of stories worth your time today, each with a line on why it matters.
- **The live wire.** Headlines from dozens of newsrooms and AI labs, ranked by how important and how fresh they are.
- **AI markets.** A live tape of the companies at the center of the AI build-out, plus the Tensor Street AI Index.
- **Main Street AI.** How ordinary businesses are putting AI to work, what's paying off, and what isn't.
- **From the Desk.** Original explainers like this one.

## How we work

We link to the reporters and labs who broke each story, and we summarize rather than republish. When we use AI to help draft something, we say so, and an editor checks it before it goes out. Market data is for information only and is never investment advice.

## Start here

New to the vocabulary? The [Learn AI glossary](/learn) explains every term you'll see on the site in a sentence or two. Then check [today's front page](/), and follow along on Instagram for the day's headlines.
